about.title: About
about.f1_desc: Every photo gets a natural-language description from a vision model.
about.f2_desc: Finds and indexes text that appears inside your photos.
about.f3_desc: Search your library by meaning, not just filenames or tags.
about.f4_desc: Finds exact and near-duplicate photos automatically.
about.f5_desc: Your library and app data stay on your computer. Photos are sent to an external provider only when you explicitly configure a remote AI model.
about.f6_desc: Use built-in local models, a local Ollama server, or a cloud provider you configure yourself (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and more). On Windows, the current recommended workflow uses cloud APIs or local Ollama while built-in local model support is being prepared.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.step1_desc: Download the file for your platform above, then open it. On macOS, if you see a warning that the app is from an unidentified developer, right-click the app and choose Open.
gettingStarted.step2_desc: On first launch, the Setup Wizard walks you through choosing which AI models to install. You can skip optional models and download them later from Settings.
gettingStarted.step3_desc: Open Settings to set your language and default photo folder. Open Models to choose which AI capabilities are active — descriptions, tagging, search, translation, and OCR.
gettingStarted.step4_title: 4. Add your photos: Watcher or Scan
gettingStarted.step4_desc: On the Folders page, add a Watcher to automatically process new photos as they arrive in a folder (ideal for syncing from your phone), or run a one-time Scan to process an existing folder of photos.
gettingStarted.step5_desc: Track progress on the Processing page, then browse your described, searchable library in the Gallery.

requirements.title: System requirements
requirements.intro: PhotoRAG is a desktop app with a Python backend. The first launch needs an internet connection because the app downloads Python packages and prepares its runtime environment.
requirements.windowsMinimum: 4 CPU cores, 2.5 GHz+, 8 GB RAM, 6–10 GB free disk space
requirements.windowsNotes: Internet required during first setup; remote AI mode requires internet access and your API key. 16 GB RAM is recommended for larger libraries.
requirements.macMinimum: 4 CPU cores, 8 GB RAM, 6–10 GB free disk space
requirements.macNotes: Internet required during first setup and for remote AI providers. Local models work better with 16 GB RAM or more.
requirements.linuxMinimum: 4 CPU cores, 2.5 GHz+, 8 GB RAM, 6–10 GB free disk space
requirements.linuxNotes: Use a recent desktop Linux distribution. Internet is required during first setup and for remote AI providers.
requirements.note: For large photo libraries, local models, or heavy OCR use, 16 GB RAM and a faster CPU are strongly recommended. GPU acceleration is optional and depends on your platform and model choices.
requirements.winarm64Minimum: 4 CPU cores, 8 GB RAM, 6–10 GB free disk space
requirements.winarm64Notes: Build available, but it needs more testing. Internet is required during first setup and for remote AI providers.
